understanding.mechanics_understanding: The player moves on a grid using directional actions. Gravity was DOWN, causing movement or settling in that direction. Each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns; landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. The recent actions showed that some moves can consume no additional step when blocked or ineffective. No click or undo behavior was observed.
